project_name: LMS Citra Negara - Sistem Pembelajaran & Administrasi Terpadu

theme.tone: Modern, Professional, Prestigious Academic (Khas Sekolah Indonesia Berkarakter)
theme.aesthetic_fusion: Modern Swiss grid discipline + Indonesian prestigious institutional warmth (Deep Sapphire Navy, Warm Gold, Forest Emerald accents) + Linear-grade tactile command panels

entry_surfaces./: Institutional hero portal with quick role switcher demo login (Siswa, Guru, Admin), campus stats, and announcements banner
entry_surfaces./login: Branded split auth: Left panel showcasing Citra Negara heritage and values, right panel with quick demo-role login and credentials
entry_surfaces./dashboard: Role-aware modular command grid with urgent academic tasks, class schedule, and quick shortcuts
entry_surfaces./ppdb: Multi-step PPDB 2026 admissions workflow with admission status tracker, document requirements, and booking fee overview
entry_surfaces./materi-tugas: Bento academic repository for documents, digital modules, exam papers, and interactive student submissions
entry_surfaces./pembayaran: Financial ledger with downloadable invoice statements, instant Stripe/VA checkout, and itemized booking/registration breakdown
entry_surfaces./mentoring: 1-on-1 and group mentoring scheduling hub, reflective notes log, and teacher feedback timeline
entry_surfaces./ai-assistant: CitraBot AI Academic Assistant panel with context-aware Indonesian responses for lesson summaries, math solutions, and PPDB FAQ

layouts.global_shell: App layout with sticky sidebar on desktop (collapsed on mobile via Sheet), top persistent header with global search, role indicator badge, notification bell, AI Assistant quick trigger, and quick role toggle

grid_modes.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 with hero stats spanning 8 cols and urgent timeline spanning 4 cols
grid_modes.mentoring_calendar: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (calendar 7 cols, upcoming notes/slots 5 cols)

motion.reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential spring animations in MotionConfig or respect prefers-reduced-motion

hero_school.alt: Perpustakaan & Gedung Utama SMK / SMA Citra Negara
hero_school.usage: Landing page hero, PPDB banner, and login background side panel

students_classroom.alt: Siswa-siswi Citra Negara dalam kegiatan belajar interaktif
students_classroom.usage: Dashboard overview, PPDB testimoni & aktivitas sekolah

teacher_mentoring.usage: Halaman Mentoring, konseling BK, dan bimbingan tugas akhir

role_management.demo_switcher: Instant one-click demo role selector in the navbar with pre-filled mock credentials (Ahmad Fauzi - Siswa, Ibu Sri Wahyuni - Guru, Pak Hendra - Admin PPDB & Keuangan)
role_management.permissions: Admin has full PPDB verification + fee management; Guru manages class docs, tasks grading, mentoring logs; Siswa submits tasks, books mentoring, checks invoices, asks AI

materi_dan_dokumen.structure: Kategori: Materi Pelajaran (PDF/Slides/Video links), Tugas & Ujian (due date, submission dropzone, score badge), Dokumen Resmi (Surat Keterangan, Kurikulum Merdeka, Kalender Akademik)
materi_dan_dokumen.features: Filter by mata pelajaran, search dokumen, status pengumpulan (Selesai/Belum/Terlambat), download file simulator, feedback nilai guru

ppdb_dan_pembayaran.ppdb_flow: 1. Isi Biodata & Pilihan Jurusan/Program -> 2. Upload Berkas (KK, Ijazah, Rapor) -> 3. Pembayaran Biaya Pendaftaran & Booking Seat -> 4. Tes Pemetaan & Verifikasi -> 5. Pengumuman Kelulusan
billing_breakdown: Biaya Booking Kursi / Uang Pangkal Awal (Rp 1.500.000)
ppdb_dan_pembayaran.payment_actions: Checkout simulator with Stripe / Virtual Account / QRIS receipt generation and downloadable invoice PDF format

mentoring_system.features: Daftar Mentor Guru & Konselor BK, Pilih Jadwal Slot Kosong, Form Topik Konsultasi (Akademik, Karir, Pribadi), Riwayat Sesi & Catatan Tindak Lanjut Mentor

chatbot_ai_assistant.name: CitraBot AI
quick_prompts: Jelaskan ringkasan materi Hukum Newton Fisika
Apa saja syarat dokumen pendaftaran PPDB 2026?
Bagaimana cara mengajukan keringanan biaya SPP?
Buatkan jadwal belajar efektif untuk persiapan Ujian
chatbot_ai_assistant.capabilities: Smart Indonesian educational tutoring, PPDB FAQ solver, task schedule recommendation, with simulated instant stream response

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app in React 19 + Tailwind v4 using JavaScript (.jsx). Ensure all routes are declared cleanly in App.jsx.
Implement the 3 demo user roles (Siswa, Guru, Admin) accessible via quick-switch toggle buttons on the topbar or login screen.
Use Indonesian language across all UI elements ('Tugas', 'Materi', 'Pembayaran SPP & PPDB', 'Mentoring', 'Jadwal Kelas', 'Asisten AI').

Include rich pre-seeded data for Citra Negara: realistic courses (Matematika, Bahasa Indonesia, Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak, IPA, Sejarah), tasks with due dates, payment records with invoice downloads, and mentoring sessions.
For payments: implement a comprehensive list of school fees (Biaya Registrasi, Booking Sekolah, SPP, Seragam), checkout dialog simulator, status badges (Lunas, Menunggu Pembayaran), and invoice view.
For PPDB: include a multi-step registration wizard, document upload simulation, status verification for Admin, and student registration tracking.
For Mentoring: include booking calendar/slot picker, meeting link generator, and mentor private notes.
For AI Assistant: implement an interactive floating or docked panel with pre-crafted school-specific prompts and realistic streaming educational responses in Bahasa Indonesia.

Ensure all buttons, inputs, tabs, and critical status badges have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='role-switch-guru', data-testid='ppdb-submit-button', data-testid='pay-booking-fee-button', data-testid='ai-chat-send').
Avoid generic raw tables—use clean card containers with 1px border (#E2E8F0), subtle hover lifts, clear status badges, and generous spacing (p-6, gap-6).

accessibility.min_contrast_ratio: 4.5:1 for regular text, 3:1 for large display headers
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Ensure dialogs, dropdowns, and tablists are fully navigable with Tab/Arrow keys
